linuxLockCorrection.symptom: Unexpected Busy between sequential completed writes; Linux 840 passed, 1 failed; Windows passed.
linuxLockCorrection.deterministicReproduction: Production Acquire, real dup of its uniquely observed procfs descriptor, Dispose, then reacquire while the duplicate remains open. Old close-only disposal failed with Busy; explicit unlock passed, and repeated old Dispose preserved true contention for a later owner.

linuxLockCorrection.limit: The CI run did not trace an actual fork. Descriptor-retention semantics were reproduced with dup; fork timing is the inferred trigger, not a claimed captured observation.
linuxLockCorrection.fix: Explicit LOCK_UN with SafeFileHandle lifetime protection, then close; Interlocked idempotence. No retries, skipped checks or weakened exclusion.
linuxLockCorrection.independentReadOnlyReview: No concrete ABI, ownership or lifecycle issue found.
